newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Skoda Auto sees end-1999 output at 500,000.
newsitem.headline: Skoda Auto sees end-1999 output at 500,000.

text.p: Czech car maker Skoda Automobilova a.s., a unit of Germany's Volkswagen AG, said on Thursday that annual output should rise to 500,000 units by the end of the century, from 263,193 units in 1996.
"Half a million Skoda automobiles (per year) by the end of the decade is a realistic target," outgoing vice-chairman Volkhard Kohler said in a statement.
